verdict.rationale: PostHog documents real programmatic surfaces: a published OpenAPI spec, OAuth-scoped API access, an MCP server that can read and write across its products, a CLI, and explicit programmatic management of feature flags and experiments. No evidence states that the API matches the UI for every feature, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party claim of API/UI parity, documented API coverage for areas like surveys, replays, dashboards and cohorts, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://posthog.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Once connected, your agent can read and write across PostHog's products.
Evaluate flags at runtime and manage flag definitions from your own tooling and CI.
Manage experiments, holdouts, and shared metrics programmatically from your own systems.
OAuth lets users grant your app scoped access without sharing their personal API key.
The PostHog CLI lets you use PostHog from your terminal, your coding agents, local scripts, and CI/CD pipelines.
